title: 👀 Doomsday plane (73-1676) coming into sight: closest in about 5 min, look SW, about 49° up, 5 mi away
body:
@RDBFarm — Doomsday plane (73-1676, E-4B Nightwatch) is worth looking for from the farm (2026-11-24 19:29:11 UTC).

- **At its closest** (in about 5 min): look SW (bearing 215°), about 49° above the horizon, 4.6 miles away, about 18,216 ft up
- **Right now:** SE (bearing 139°), 27.1 miles away, about 8,317 ft above the farm's ground, heading NW, 259 kt
- **Callsign:** not broadcast; ICAO ADFEB3

[ADS-B Exchange](https://globe.adsbexchange.com/?icao=adfeb3) · [Farm receiver (farm network only)](http://192.168.1.190/tar1090/?icao=adfeb3) · [Live map](https://rdbfarm.github.io/iad-map/live.html)

_Automatic alert from `pi/alerts.py`, once per visit. Its path is projected straight ahead at its present course, speed and climb or descent; it alerts only when that path is in sight (within 12 miles, at least 5° up) within 5 minutes for at least a minute. Those limits are estimates; a turn changes the path, and cloud isn't known._
